customer_name: Guangdong Joint Electronic Toll Service Co., Ltd. (广东联合电子服务股份有限公司)
business_problem: Joint Electronic Toll Service needed to govern massive highway transaction and mobility data, support more than 25 million ETC users, and turn that data into AI-assisted operational decisions for tolling, traffic prediction, and road-network safety.
solution_summary: Guangdong Joint Electronic Toll Service built a Huawei Cloud data and AI stack to turn highway transaction and mobility data into operational products and AI decisions. DataArts Studio standardizes and governs raw entry, exit, and gantry records across Guangdong's toll network, while Data Lake Insight (DLI) provides the analytical engine for multi-source traffic computation with a serverless, storage-compute-separated architecture that can scale to 20,000 cores in minutes. The governed data is organized into models, asset views, and six product lines with 63 data products. On top of that data base, the company uses ModelArts and domain algorithms for traffic-flow forecasting and smart toll auditing. Daily vehicle passage data, video feeds, and checkpoint images are cleaned and modeled, then processed for AI prediction, abnormal-transaction recognition, and decision support for operators, drivers, police, transport agencies, and emergency-management stakeholders.

solution_components.name: DataArts Studio
solution_components.role: Standardizes and governs raw toll-road data throughout its lifecycle.

solution_components.name: Data Lake Insight (DLI)
solution_components.role: Provides elastic large-scale analysis across multiple traffic data sources and formats.

solution_components.name: ModelArts
solution_components.role: Supports the development and operationalization of AI scenarios on top of the governed data base.

solution_components.name: traffic-flow prediction algorithm
solution_components.role: Forecasts highway traffic volumes from spatiotemporal toll and road-network data.

solution_components.name: smart toll-auditing application
solution_components.role: Identifies abnormal transactions and helps verify toll routes and charges automatically.

data_flow: Vehicle passage records, toll-station and gantry data, video-monitoring streams, and checkpoint images are standardized in DataArts Studio, then processed in DLI for batch and streaming analytics. The curated data feeds ModelArts and traffic-domain algorithms for forecasting and anomaly detection, with outputs delivered into toll auditing, network operations, and external decision-support workflows.
business_outcome: The platform improved development productivity, turned highway data into tradable products, and delivered AI-assisted traffic forecasting and anomaly detection that improve road-network operations and traveler safety.
